ANIMATION_FIREFORGET_BOW == Drink
ANIMATION_FIREFORGET_GREETING == Cheers!
ANIMATION_FIREFORGET_PAUSE_SCRATCH_HEAD == Double Drink w/ Mouth Wipe
ANIMATION_FIREFORGET_SALUTE == Cheers! w/ Drink
ANIMATION_FIREFORGET_STEAL == Drink
ANIMATION_LOOPING_CUSTOM1 == Play Music Animation
ANIMATION_LOOPING_CUSTOM2 == Custom Sit Animation 2*
ANIMATION_LOOPING_LOOK_FAR == Pause Drunk
ANIMATION_LOOPING_MEDITAT == Pause Drunk
ANIMATION_LOOPING_SIT_CROSS == Custom Sit Animation 1*
ANIMATION_LOOPING_WORSHIP == Pause Drunk

*Custom Looping Sit 1 -
    This animation will take a single drink with a long pause in between.
*Custom Looping Sit 2 -
    This animation will take a double drink and then a single drink with a long     pause between them.

    Together with the normal sit animation for this phenotype (which will hold its     cup table height like the others, but never drink), you are not forced to just     see the same animation on all tavern patrons.

Notes:

	Changing Appearance of NPC - 						        To change the appearance of the pc, you will need to switch the phenotype to normal, select OK, and then reopen the creature properties window and make adjustments. Just make sure to set back to social phenotype after you change the appearance. 

	Make NPC Sit-									 There are 3 choices when it comes to sitting. You can disregard my scripts and use the BioWare nw_c2_sitting script in the heartbeat of the NPC. This will cause it to sit like normal, except with his mug held at table height. Using this animation, the NPC will never drink from his mug. The other two choices for sitting use the scripts I included in the .erf file. These are set using variables on the NPC object. Details on these can be found below, under "Advanced Settings".

Advanced Settings:

	Variables:

	integer "BUSY" - if this is set to 1, this NPC will not get up from his chair when selected by the PC (you can still start a conversation with the NPC even if you use this setting. Directions for this are below).               
	integer "SITTING" - if this is set to 1, the NPC will create a stool* (needs    social_stool blueprint to work!) and sit there for a very long time, playing my Custom Looping Sit 1 animation. If this is set to 2, the NPC will create a stool* (needs social_stool blueprint to work!) and sit there for a very long time, playing my Custom Looping Sit 2 animation.
	       *when integer "SITTING" is set to 1, integer "BUSY" defaults                          to 1 and string "BUSY", if not set, will default to one of 4                                 appropriate sounds (most of them are burps, I think)
 	string "BUSY" - set this to any sound resref and the PC will hear  this when this NPC is selected (can be any sound resource in the game)            	        *if set to "CONVERSATION", & the NPC's chair tag is                          "SIT"+tag     of  NPC, the chair will attempt to start a                                        conversation with the PC that selected this NPC (if integer                          "SITTING" is set to 1 or 2, the stool the NPC creates to sit on                          will automatically be given the correct tag for this to work).
 	                 *I also set the name of the stool to the name of the NPC                                   in the script when it's created. This will help convince                                   you that you are talking to a NPC that just won't look up                                   if you actually have them start a conversation.
	                 *This conversation should be placed in the placeable's                                       conversation slot and that placeable should be set to                                    static. (The conversation can be any name, as long as                                    it is placed inside the placeables conversation slot.)
	-string "SocialChairResRef" :if you want to make a copy of the social stool object and add a custom conversation to it, use this to point the NPC to the correct stool object blueprint. if left blank, it will use the blueprint I created with no conversation.
                                    * I set the stool to be created as a local object on this                                        NPC 
                        <  SetLocalObject(OBJECT_SELF,"MySocialStool",oStool); >
                           ...you might find this useful in setting up scripts on the stool                            or the pc to destroy the stool if he gets up or whatever (even                            if he is set to busy, if combat breaks out in the tavern, he will                            get up from his stool. This would be bad, because the stool                            placeable has no walk mesh so the NPC will appear to be                            seated on it. You don't want these to be sitting around with                            PCs able to walk through them. They are already set to be                            destroyed when the NPC is finished with the animation, but I                            did not account for an interruption of the animation).

Scripts:

There are 5 scripts I made for this project. They are:
 	cut_and_paste - this script is not really a script, just a few lines that need cut and pasted into your module's OnActivateItem event script to allow the music script and animation to work as intended.
 	tbx0_banjo01 - this script is designed to simulate playing music. It will cause the PC to "equip" my musical instrument and play the animations for it. Of course, a play music animation without music is just silly, so there one of 2 appropriate tunes will play during the animation.
 	tbx0_social_conv - this is the normal conversation script. I just edited it slightly to add the possibility of the NPC being "busy" (won't stand up when selected, but can still have a conversation with the PC). There are notes on how to set this up in the advanced settings section.
 	tbx0_social_hb - this script is super simple for heartbeat and not CPU intensive in any way. It simply switches a random integer with each heartbeat to decide which animation should be played next. This is done to mix things up a bit so most of the animations will play without any changes to the scripting.
 	tbx0_social_ud - this script is the core of the social phenotypes behavior. It tells the phenotype what it should do, whether that be play one of the sitting animations or cycle thru the other random animations and actions I set up for it.

Notes on Scripting:
You can use any NPC behavior scripts with this phenotype with no trouble, I guess. I simply made the scripts listed above to make set-up and use of this system as simple as possible for those that are not as experienced at working with the toolset.

enjoy!
  -Tom_Banjo

This is the default waypoint you may place to set a patrol path for a creature or NPC.
1. Create the creature and either use its current Tag or fill in a new one.
2. Place or make sure the WalkWayPoints() is within the body of the On Spawn script for the creature.
3. Place a series of waypoints along the route you wish the creature to walk.
4. Select all of the newly created waypoints and right click. Choose the Create Set option.
5. The waypoint set will have a set name of "WP_" + NPC Tag. Thus if an NPC with the Tag "Guard" will have a waypoint set called "WP_Guard". Note that Tags are case sensitive.
